paragraphs: Rav Ada bar Chama: Bava Metzia 30a.
Rabbi Assi bar Chama: Bava Kamma 93a. Guria bar Chama: Berakhot 53b. Ze’ira bar Chama: Yoma 78b.
Rabbi Chanina bar Chama, the well-known sage.
Rabbi Yaakov bar Chama: Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim, chapter 2, halakhah 2.
Rabbi Levi bar Chama: Taanit 16a. Mar Ukva bar Chama: Berakhot 44a.
Rabbi Pinchas bar Chama: Bava Batra 116a. Rami bar Chama: Berakhot 44a.

notes.text: This notice lists fourteen people with the patronymic bar Chama. It does not establish that all fourteen had one father. The inspected Berakhot 44a directly names Rami bar Chama and Mar Ukva bar Chama; no general family merger follows.
